name: Dolanaar has Sylindra Starweave training riding and Maelira Rider selling frostsaber reins
contract: On Ascension, Sylindra Starweave 449169 <Traveling Riding Trainer>, Maelira Rider 449168 <Traveling Mount
Merchant> and a Riding Striped Frostsaber 12358 stood by the Dolanaar stable; the server had none of them.
Maelira sold Reins of the Ancient Frostsaber 12302 and Reins of the Nightsaber 12303 at 100g (db.exil.es).
Expected: both NPCs spawn in Dolanaar; Sylindra offers riding training with Novice Riding 33379 available to
an Alliance player of any race; Maelira's shop holds exactly the two reins at 100g each. They stay all year,
including while Pilgrim's Bounty (game event 26) runs.
